title: ExtendedTimetable
description: Traffic, errors, accounts, CIST sync and the server of ExtendedTimetable.

panels.title: Status
panels.description: Whether Prometheus could scrape extt's /metrics in the last 15 seconds.

panels.title: Requests / min
panels.description: Requests served per minute, averaged over 5 minutes. Static files and /healthz are included.

panels.title: 5xx errors
panels.description: Share of requests that failed with a server error, over 5 minutes.

panels.title: p95 response time
panels.description: 95% of requests in the last 5 minutes were answered faster than this.

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Time since extt last started (a deploy or a restart).

panels.title: Signed in
panels.description: Users with at least one unexpired session (sessions last 30 days).

panels.title: Homework
panels.description: Homework assignments in all groups.

panels.title: Open feedback
panels.description: Feedback not resolved yet: /admin/feedback.

panels.title: Database size
panels.description: The SQLite file, without the WAL.

panels.title: Requests by status
panels.description: 3xx are mostly redirects after a form is sent; 4xx are pages not found, forbidden or invalid forms.

panels.title: Response time
panels.description: Half (p50), 95% and 99% of requests were answered faster than these lines.

panels.title: Requests by page
panels.description: The ten busiest routes. A route is the URL pattern, e.g. /g/{code}/homework for every group.

panels.title: Slowest pages (p95, selected range)
panels.description: Routes ordered by their 95th percentile response time over the time range picked at the top.

panels.title: Logins
panels.description: Login attempts. rate_limited: more than 30 tries from one IP or 10 for one username in 15 minutes.

panels.title: New accounts
panels.description: Accounts created through invite links.

panels.title: Rejected requests (CSRF / cross-origin)
panels.description: Forms sent without a valid CSRF token, or from another site. A few are normal (a page left open for days); a burst may be an attack.

panels.title: Last successful sync per group
panels.description: Syncs run every 6 hours. Yellow: one run missed; red: two (the ExttScheduleStale alert).

panels.title: Sync time
panels.description: Time to fetch one group's timetable from CIST, averaged over the syncs of the last 7 hours (they run every 6). Each CIST server is given 12 s.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: 1 = one full CPU core.

panels.title: Network
panels.description: Received above zero, sent below.
